questions.question: Explain how fertilizers are applied at different stages of tea plant growth. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain how fertilizers are applied at different stages of tea plant growth. [U] /[CO3]
  • Nursery stage – balanced fertilizers to Support seedling growth- FYM , phosphate , Urea monthly. Young
  • tea – NPK
  • Mature tea 4 yrs onwards NPK
  • Pruned year – NPK , add required fertilizers for shoot development
  • Harvesting stage- nitrogen based fertilizer to support continuous leaf production.
  • Apply fertilizer when soil is moist , keep them away from stem and water is necessary.

questions.question: Describe the relationship between proper postharvest handling, quality control, and shelf life of plantation crops. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the relationship between proper postharvest handling, quality control, and shelf life of
  • plantation crops. [U] /[CO5]
  • Post Harvest Handling: Harvest at right maturity (coffee red cherry, tea two leaves and bud, coconut 12
  • months, rubber early morning), quick transport, proper processing (washing, withering, drying, smoking,
  • mechanical bruishing, grading, sorting, drying, proper packing).
  • Quality Control: Drying to safe moisture ,prevents Aspergillus Ochratoxin , grading size/density, vacuum
  • packing, Agmark certification, QC establishes measurable standard - moisture content, bean/leaf size,
  • color, oil content, chemical purity, and absence of forgein matter or mycotoxins .
  • Shelf life:Harvest at correct maturity, quick pre – processing, proper drying,cleaning and grading, scientific
  • storage, value addition , appropriate preservatiobn methods, inspect product regularly.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Differentiate between broad-spectrum and selective pesticides. / [CO5] [5x8 = 40]
questions.solution_html:
• Differentiate between broad-spectrum and selective pesticides. [U] /[CO5]
  • Broad-spectrum - kills wide range of pests+beneficials, e.g Malathion, Mancozeb, Bordeaux. Kills
  • pollinators, not IPM compatible, disturb natural ecosystem, biomagnification, cheap quick action.
  • Selective - kills only specific target, e.g. Bt for caterpillars , Neem, pheromones. Safe for beneficials like
  • ladybird, bees, Integrated Pest Managment compatible , biodegradable , maintain ecological balance.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
